set_desc: Merge fields into a SoundConcurrency asset's Concurrency settings (maxCount, resolutionRule, volume scaling...; absent keys kept), clamp to ClampMin/ClampMax and save; set_properties neither clamps nor saves. Keys match field names case-insensitively. An empty settings object, a key that names no field (the error lists them), a null value, or a value that is not of the field's kind or does not convert is an error and nothing changes. A failed save makes success false.
settings_desc: Object of FSoundConcurrencySettings fields to merge (maxCount(int>=1), bLimitToOwner(bool), resolutionRule(enum name), retriggerTime, volumeScale(0..1), volumeScaleMode(enum), bVolumeScaleCanRelease, volumeScaleAttackTime, volumeScaleReleaseTime, voiceStealReleaseTime); absent keys untouched. Keys match the field names case-insensitively; an empty object, a key that names no field, a null value or a value that does not convert is an error and nothing is changed.
get_desc: Read the whole FSoundConcurrencySettings struct (maxCount, bLimitToOwner, resolutionRule, retriggerTime, volume scaling, voice stealing) of a USoundConcurrency asset as one settings object, with the keys set_sound_concurrency_properties takes, plus asset_class. A convenience over get_properties on its Concurrency property, shaped for that write tool. Read-only.
